# MAXY AI

> MAXY AI is a Singapore agentic AI and software company. It builds custom AI agents, AI-native web and mobile applications, and digital growth systems for SMEs.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.maxy.asia/): Company overview, markets served, and core capabilities.
- [Solutions](https://www.maxy.asia/solutions): Agentic AI, custom software, web and app development, and digital growth services.
- [Agentic AI Development](https://www.maxy.asia/solutions/agentic-ai): Custom AI agents for sales, support, operations, assessments, hospitality, and internal knowledge workflows.
- [Web and Mobile App Development](https://www.maxy.asia/solutions/web-app): Websites, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS products, internal systems, and integrations.
- [Digital Marketing and SEO](https://www.maxy.asia/solutions/digital-growth): SEO, GEO, content, performance creative, landing pages, analytics, and lead generation.
- [AI Transformation Roadmap](https://www.maxy.asia/roadmap): A phased approach from the first AI agent to connected multi-workflow automation.
- [Contact](https://www.maxy.asia/contact): Strategy-call information, company locations, and contact details.
